name: SideMenu
intent: Vertical navigation panel for a content-area sub-surface (settings, integrations, filters): owns its own header (optional back button + icon + title), optional search, and grouped items with an active state.
when: A content region needs its own left-hand navigation column, separate from the app shell sidebar
Entering a settings/integrations/detail sub-surface that should provide a back path to the owning module
Grouped, optionally-searchable navigation with section labels and per-item icons
whenNot: The persistent application shell navigation is required -> use CoreAppSidebar
Peer tabs across the top of a route -> use PageContentHeader (navigation variant) with ViewTabBar

chooseOver.because: SideMenu is a content-local sub-navigation panel; CoreAppSidebar owns the persistent app shell.

allowedPlacement: Left column of a content region, paired with a content panel on the right
forbiddenPlacement: As the persistent application shell sidebar
Inside a Card, Dialog, or table row
minimalExample: <SideMenu title="Settings" onBack={goBack} groups={[{items: [{id: "general", label: "General"}]}, {label: "Workspace", items: [{id: "members", label: "Members"}]}]} activeItemId={active} onItemSelect={setActive} />

extracted: grouped items with section labels and active state

notes: introduced with the Safety Manager Settings sub-surface

usage: Use SideMenu to help users navigate through your application or content hierarchy. This component provides clear wayfinding and helps users understand their current location within the interface.

SideMenu is ideal for multi-page applications, content-heavy interfaces, or any situation where users need to move between different sections. Keep navigation patterns consistent across your application for better user experience.

props.name: title
props.description: Panel title shown in the header.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon shown before the title.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the back button. Defaults to "Back".

props.name: showSearch
props.description: Show the search field. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Controlled search value; pair with `onSearchChange`. Uncontrolled when omitted.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

anatomy.description: SideMenu is composed of the following parts:

parts.name: SideMenuTrigger
parts.description: Element that opens the menu when activated.

bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
